q23.

The `Memo` entity is defined at each layer here (one file per layer; the SQL schema exists in three dialect variants):

- SQL schema: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql` (memo table at line 33; equivalent definitions in `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:32` and `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:32`)
- Go store model: `store/memo.go`
- API proto message: `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (generated Go binding in `proto/gen/api/v1/memo_service.pb.go`)
- Generated frontend types: `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`
